⚪ MiniGo

A simplified Go game: place stones on a grid to surround territory. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Place stones on empty intersections — one per turn.
  2. Surround empty space to claim it as territory.
  3. Capture opponent stones by surrounding them completely (no liberties).
  4. Captured stones are removed and count as points for the captor.
  5. Two consecutive passes end the game — count territory to determine the winner.
